title: Current-flow registry freeze
acceptance_conditions: Every current flow object has stable identity, grain, owner, dependencies and authority.
Every marker rule is functionally classified without C2.5 semantic authority.
Every attempted evaluation maps to a closed computability status and exact reason code.
Every metric has an exact numerator, denominator, unit and zero-denominator policy.
Material registry amendments require operator acknowledgement and deterministic rerun.
Focused, retained and complete tests pass on the exact final head.
rollback: Supersede through a new registry version and amendment; preserve all historical registries and evidence.
exact_work_after_approval: Squash-merge MTA-WP1, record merge receipt, create audit/mta-wp2-source-c1 from main and continue through MTA-G2.
